scoring.rule: Each explicitly listed deliverable, API, requirement, or acceptance condition in one F0-F6 work package is one fixed point. Repeated requirements are owned by one primary package and are not double-counted.
scoring.architectural_qualifier_rule: When a package requires event-first, reducer-native, active, durable, shared-service, or production wiring, a legacy or opt-in contract with similar fields earns no point unless that qualifier is satisfied.
scoring.done_rule: A point is complete only when implementation and its required tests, documentation, persistence parity, or operational evidence are present.
scoring.rotation_rule: After the same acceptance item remains incomplete through two consecutive completion attempts, record the evidence and blocker, leave its points incomplete, and work on another independent item before returning.
scoring.denominator_change_rule: The 345-point denominator is immutable for this plan digest. A different denominator requires a new ledger version and a new source-plan digest; historical reports remain unchanged.
